scientific_integrity: Explicit finite verification is corroboration rather than an infinite proof; original proofs and enumerators are presented with exact hypotheses and boundaries.
scientific_limitations: Complete graph factors only, with m,n>=2; no generalization to other line graphs, higher tuple domination or more product factors. Publication priority provisional, independent audit not performed.
title: Minimal total domination of rook graphs: a three-regime component enumerator
